title: Job Loyalty Is Costing You $147,000
hook: Your loyalty to your employer is costing you six figures — and HR departments are literally banking on it.
angle: Most workers assume staying loyal earns rewards — but companies budget more for strangers than loyal employees, and the math proves it's a losing strategy
audience: Full-time employees who haven't changed jobs in 2+ years and assume loyalty pays off
key_numbers: Average raise for staying: 3% (often below inflation)
Average salary jump when switching jobs: 10-20%
Over 10 years, job-hoppers earn ~$147,000 more in cumulative income
Companies pay external hires 18-20% more than internal candidates for the same role
72% of employees stay 5+ years, losing compounding salary gains
